subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-class durable subagent lifecycle and supervision API now, and what is the minimal public contract?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses persisted state, Gateway protocol, task/artifact/audit boundaries, and security-sensitive control semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the stable API shape.

options.title: Design Bounded Core Receipt API
options.body: Add a metadata-only ordered subagent lifecycle receipt linked to tasks, artifacts, and audit records plus audited cancel, steer, and resume semantics as the core contract.

options.title: Split Narrow Fixes Only
options.body: Leave the broad lifecycle contract undecided and handle only the narrower UI timeline or Telegram liveness issues in their own threads.

options.title: Expose Plugin Seams First
options.body: Keep core minimal and add only the generic hooks needed for external plugins or dashboards to build richer lifecycle and supervision surfaces.

recommendation.title: Design Bounded Core Receipt API
recommendation.body: Add a metadata-only ordered subagent lifecycle receipt linked to tasks, artifacts, and audit records plus audited cancel, steer, and resume semantics as the core contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across background task visibility, gateway task events, and the product boundary that would expose this contract.
